faq.does_it_need_an_internet: Does it need an internet connection?
faq.no_voice_navigation_and_mapping: No. Voice, navigation and mapping run on the chair. A connection adds remote monitoring, elevator calls and updates.
faq.folded_cihang_is_510_mm: 510 mm tall folded, down from 880 mm. It fits a wardrobe, a car trunk or an elevator without taking anything apart.
faq.can_i_still_drive_it: Can I still drive it myself?
faq.yes_use_the_joystick_touchscreen: Yes. Joystick, touchscreen, gestures or app, any time. Let go of the joystick and it stops. Self-driving is a mode you choose.
faq.older_adults_who_want_to: Older adults living at home, people recovering from surgery or injury, long-term wheelchair users and their families. Institutions use the Shared version. See where it is used.
faq.cihang_is_registered_as_a: NMPA Class II medical device, tested to GB/T 12996-2024 and GB/T 18029 / ISO 7176. Also certified: CE (MDR, RoHS), FDA 510(k), FCC, KC, MFDS and UN38.3.
faq.the_personal_version_is_sold: Personal: sold online, direct. Shared: for institutions, through WDC Robot.
